decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product that stayed on its own webpage across 2023 and 2024, it reflects visible investment and strategic fit, so management is likely to justify continuing it and treat any weakness as temporary.

Although the firm publicly backed it with its own page in 2024, the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the established portfolio and announced direction, so commitment is weaker and management is more likely to redeploy resources to core medical-technology lines.

The post-curing unit is close to the firm's digital production trajectory and benefits from recent development spending, so escalation of commitment makes management inclined to continue it despite its still modest website prominence.
